@llm-series monorepo

LLM Agent Playground

6 interactive labs covering the full LLM agent stack — from raw API calls to multi-agent routing. Each lab is backed by a real @llm-series module you can explore and extend.

Lab 1
llm-clientprompt-template

Chat & Streaming

Interact with OpenAI or Anthropic using a unified client. Use prompt templates with variables.

→
Lab 2
structured-output

Structured Output

Extract and validate JSON from LLM responses using Zod schemas. See each extraction step.

→
Lab 3
tool-registrysimple-react-agent

ReAct Agent

Run a multi-step agent that reasons and calls tools. Visualize the Thought→Action→Observation loop.

→
Lab 4
memory-store

Memory Store

Chat with a sliding-window memory. Watch entries get evicted when the context fills up.

→
Lab 5
chunkerembeddervector-store-literetriever

RAG Pipeline

Ingest documents → chunk → embed → store vectors → retrieve by similarity → generate answers.

→
Lab 6
agent-router

Multi-Agent Router

Let an LLM classify your query and route it to the most appropriate specialized agent.

→

Setup: Copy .env.example → .env.local and add your API keys. Labs 1–4 and 6 need OPENAI_API_KEY or ANTHROPIC_API_KEY. Lab 5 (RAG) additionally needs an embeddings key.
